rationale: Archive Palmetto corporate from the infrastructure PortCo list. I Squared's interest is InfraTech venture and growth equity in a residential-solar marketplace and software-enabled service platform, not direct ownership of the installed energy assets. Palmetto HASI Holdings LLC is a separate HASI-backed asset joint venture and is not treated as the I Squared holding represented by this task.
